messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: org=NebulaSys | endpoint=/v1/generate | qps ~3.4x baseline | 5xx spike 12% | dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example/alerts/1909123456

maya-oncall: on it. paged rachel-cs to confirm customer activity. grabbing runbook link — https://go/redwood/runbooks/tenant-rate-spike

rachel-cs: confirmed. NebulaSys doing a large customer launch, they're hitting bursts from a new retry loop. Asked for temporary relief — priority: keep them live while we stabilize. :pray:

liam-eng: ok. quick plan: 1) apply time-limited org-quota bump to NebulaSys (30m) 2) add traffic-shaping to limit concurrent streams to 2 3) route NebulaSys to redwood-medium-1 variant for heavy requests. will post admin commands.

maya-oncall: +1 to that. also let's disable nonessential reranking for that org to reduce token churn. I'll run the bump and shaping now.

liam-eng: command to bump (use admin API):
```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/orgs/NebulaSys/overrides 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' 
  -d '{"rate_limit_qps": 250, "ttl_seconds": 1800, "note": "Emergency relief for launch - ops ticket #12345"}'
```

maya-oncall: running it now.

deploy-bot: action_log: POST /orgs/NebulaSys/overrides 200 OK (req_id=ab12cd34) - override applied (rate_limit_qps=250, ttl=1800)

maya-oncall: override applied. also pushed route change to model-variant: `NebulaSys -> redwood-medium-1` for requests with cost>500 tokens. rolling immediately.

dave-sre: added a traffic-shaper rule to cap concurrent_streams=2 for org=NebulaSys (policy id ts-998). This will queue surplus requests with fair-queueing, not drop.

liam-eng: I've disabled reranking for NebulaSys (feature flag ff:rerank_nss=false) for the same TTL. command: `go/flags set --org NebulaSys rerank_nss=false --ttl 1800`

maya-oncall: watching host and queue metrics. GPU utilization dropped from 92% -> 68% in the last 90s. 5xx rate down to 1.3%. Looks stable.

rachel-cs: I've updated the customer (NebulaSys SRE) and logged consent for temporary changes. They're rolling a fix; expect traffic to normalize in ~25-40m.

ana-pm: can we capture the mitigation steps for postmortem? I'll open a short ops-ticket and link to this thread. We'll need owner for follow-up on retry-loop root cause.

maya-oncall: creating follow-up ticket: OPS-12345, assigning to liam-eng for postmortem and recommending client-side backoff enforcement.

liam-eng: noted. I'll dig into the client's traffic pattern and the gateway logs; will post findings to OPS-12345.

maya-oncall: handing off monitoring to dave-sre (night shift) in 25m. If anything regresses, please ping pager. Otherwise we'll let the TTL expire and the override will auto-revert.

dave-sre: ack. I'll keep a 30m watch and escalate if 5xx>3% or GPU>80% again.

deploy-bot: scheduled_task: override-expiry-check for NebulaSys at 1909125256 (will auto-revert).

maya-oncall: thanks team — closing active mitigation. leaving thread open for postmortem notes. :thumbsup:
